color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
<prefix>_meg_001.cMEG (+ _002, …)
• signal samples → raw data, read with raw.get_data()
(MEG converted V→T; trigger and BNC lines kept in V)
• time row → check: sampling rate, gaps between parts

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
<prefix>_meg.json
• SamplingFrequency → info['sfreq']
• TaskDescription → info['description']
• RecordingDuration → check: data length
• RecordingType → check: empty room vs subject
• PowerLineFrequency → ignored (Cerca writes 0)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
<prefix>_channels.tsv
• name → info['ch_names'], info['chs'][i]['ch_name']
• type (MEGMAG / TRIG / MISC) → info['chs'][i]['kind']
• gain V0x2FnT (V/nT) → V→T scaling of the data
• status = bad → info['bads']

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
<prefix>_HelmConfig.tsv
• Sensor → matched to channel name
• Px Py Pz → info['chs'][i]['loc'][0:3] (position)
• Ox Oy Oz → info['chs'][i]['loc'][9:12] (sensing direction;
loc[3:9] = the two perpendicular axes)
• channel with no helmet slot → kind = FIFFV_REF_MEG_CH
• helmet name → log

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
<prefix>_SessionInfo.txt (or --session-info)
• recording started (UTC) → info['meas_date']
• Operator → info['experimenter']
• Comments → info['description']
• OPM V/nT → check: gains in channels.tsv
• Room Degaussed, Experiment Type → checks
• Patient ID, Ethics Code → log only

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
File-name prefix YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS
• local start time → info['meas_date']
(fallback, and cross-check of SessionInfo)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
--xfm e.g. *_dev2head_xfm.tsv
• 4×4 device → digitisation transform
→ info['dev_head_t']['trans'] (with the fiducials)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
--dig e.g. *_digitisation.xyz
• NAS, LPA, RPA → info['dig'] (kind = cardinal);
define the head frame for info['dev_head_t']
• head-shape points → info['dig'] (kind = extra)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
cMEG_peripherals.tsv (or --peripherals)
• BNC type → info['chs'][i]['kind'] (stim / misc) or dropped
• BNC name → info['ch_names'] (renamed)
• button order → STI_BTN bit values

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Command-line options
• --timezone → converts the file-name time to UTC
• --line-freq → info['line_freq'] (default 60)
• --min-samples → STI101 / STI_BTN glitch merging
• --max-hsp → number of head-shape points in info['dig']
• --double → float64 instead of float32 on disk
• --out, --force → output name, overwrite
• --no-plot → skip 3D alignment check

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FIF data — raw.get_data(picks=...)
• MEG channels in tesla (picks='mag' / 'ref_meg')
• Trigger1[Z] … Trigger8[Z] + combined STI101
• R_thumb … L_pinky + combined STI_BTN (picks='stim')
• eye_x, eye_y, eye_pupil, other BNC in volts (picks='misc')

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FIF info — from the inputs (raw.info[...])
• info['sfreq'] ← meg.json
• info['ch_names'], info['chs'][i]['kind']
← channels.tsv, peripherals
• info['chs'][i]['loc'] ← HelmConfig
• info['bads'] ← channels.tsv
• info['meas_date'] ← SessionInfo (or file name + --timezone)
• info['description'] ← meg.json + SessionInfo
• info['experimenter'] ← SessionInfo
• info['line_freq'] ← --line-freq
• info['dig'] ← --dig
• info['dev_head_t'] ← --xfm + fiducials

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FIF info — not from the inputs (raw.info[...])
Set or corrected by cMEG2fif:
• info['chs'][i]['coil_type'] = FIFFV_COIL_QUSPIN_ZFOPM_MAG2 (8002)
• info['chs'][i]['unit'] = FIFF_UNIT_T (112) for MEG,
FIFF_UNIT_V (107) for trigger/BNC/misc
• info['chs'][i]['cal'] = 1.0 (values stored in physical units)
• info['chs'][i]['coord_frame'] = FIFFV_COORD_DEVICE for MEG
• info['device_info'] = {'type': 'Cerca', 'model': 'cMEG'}
Left at MNE defaults:
• info['highpass'] = 0.0, info['lowpass'] = 600.0 (Nyquist)
• empty, not applicable to OPM: info['hpi_meas'],
info['hpi_results'], info['hpi_subsystem'], info['comps'],
info['projs'], info['proc_history'], info['gantry_angle']
• empty by design: info['subject_info'] (set in BIDS)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
<prefix>_meg_conversion_log.txt
• provenance header (version, command, host, packages)
• SessionInfo fields, both start times
• trigger/button levels, channel summary
• all checks and warnings
